opening_message: A car-sharing platform declined my account and cited a negative debt record. I challenged the old invoice months ago, so I want to know who can see this information. The rejection email gives a source name, but I have not checked it yet.
hidden_facts: The rejection email names Betreibungsamt Zürich and refers to the official enforcement register. The underlying amount is still disputed and unpaid. It is not an entry held by a private credit-scoring provider.

gold.justification: Before relying on SchKG art. 8a, the system must establish who holds the record. An official register is within partial scope; a private credit provider would trigger referral instead.
